rules.single_model_project: target MODEL_001 when model_count=1 and no selector is necessary
rules.multi_model_project_without_selector: ASK_OR_BLOCK; never choose a random model
allowed_selectors: explicit model name/alias resolved by project alias resolver
rules.reference_image: map each person/figure to an explicit IDUNEX model; ask when mapping is unclear
rules.non_target_models: do not read non-target models unless group scene, comparison or explicit all-model request
